title: Configure clang-tidy and Clazy, analyze the C++ code, and fix actionable findings
scope: Backlog item only. Tool setup, check selection, analysis, and fixes are deferred until implementation is explicitly requested.
request: Set up clang-tidy and the Qt-focused Clazy analyzer with suitable options, analyze the project, and fix the actionable findings.
expected: A repeatable static-analysis workflow with useful checks for this Qt/C++17 project, recorded findings, and reviewed fixes that preserve intended behavior.
implementation_notes: Select tool versions compatible with the actual Qt, LLVM/Clang, and platform toolchain used for analysis. Record versions and supported execution environments rather than assuming both analyzers run directly in every installed kit.

Use a compilation database or equivalent accurate build configuration with the project's real C++ standard, defines, include paths, and generated headers. Keep desktop and Android configurations distinct.
Choose high-signal correctness, lifetime, performance, and Qt-specific checks. Evaluate check groups before enabling them; do not enable every stylistic or experimental check indiscriminately.
Check in a .clang-tidy configuration and document the Clazy check selection and repeatable invocation using mechanisms supported by the selected version.

Focus reports on project-owned sources, headers, and tests. Exclude generated moc/QML registration code and external Qt/dependency implementation warnings while retaining relevant findings attributed to project code.
Record and triage the initial findings before editing. Deduplicate findings against existing backlog items and distinguish confirmed issues from false positives.
Review each proposed fix, especially around Qt object ownership, signals/slots, implicit sharing, model notifications, and QML-facing interfaces. Do not blindly apply all automatic fixes.
Use narrow, justified suppressions only where necessary; do not hide genuine findings through broad exclusions or blanket suppressions.
Keep integration simple and coordinate build-system changes with DEV-004. Static-analysis tools should not become an unexplained prerequisite for ordinary app builds.
acceptance_criteria: Document the selected analyzer versions, check sets, build configuration, scope filters, and commands for rerunning both tools.
Run both clang-tidy and Clazy on the intended project scope and retain a useful summary of their findings.
Fix actionable findings in reviewable changes, with false positives and intentionally deferred findings explicitly accounted for.
Preserve the design principles and supported Qt/C++ build behavior; introduce no unrelated feature or formatting changes.
Rerun the relevant analysis after fixes and report remaining diagnostics with their disposition.
Run tools/verify-windows.ps1 and targeted regressions or additional platform checks warranted by the actual fixes.
Keep analyzer configuration, diagnostic evidence, and functional fixes distinguishable for review.
evidence: Explicit user request to add clang-tidy/Clazy setup, suitable options, analysis, and fixes to the backlog on 2026-10-28.
